summary: Expose real presale windows and provide an explicit, safe checkout handoff.
reason: The prior events on-sale-soon command only inspected public on-sale dates while describing itself as a presale watch. Ticketmaster Discovery returns distinct sales.presales windows and official URLs, so agents should use those fields without claiming to reserve or purchase inventory.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover upcoming/open/ended classification, opens-within filtering, presale selection priority, and rejection of unsafe checkout URLs.
